_coverageThresholdRationale: Floors were recalibrated after the Community Web client extraction: the old 85/85 line and statement floors were set when the web surfaces were single emitted template-literal modules, so their giant style/markup strings counted as covered lines and inflated the totals. The suite now measures real code, including the vite-compiled client entry (Epoch.Community.Web/dist/client/runtime.js), which executes only inside Playwright browser pages and is invisible to c8, so it reports 0% despite being exercised by the community_web_experience scenarios. Browser-only Community Web workbench views and worker entry files are excluded for the same reason. Measured actuals at recalibration: lines/statements 80.0, branches 79.4, functions 86.5 — floors sit 1-2 points below those actuals (functions and branches ratchet UP from 79/75). New behavior must preserve or improve these floors; if client-entry instrumentation lands, raise lines/statements back toward 85.
